plugins.name: OmniFlow
plugins.description: Android GUI automation powered by the OmniFlow VLM runtime.

description.zh: Debug APK 已内置并启用完整 GUI/VLM 插件；安装 APK 后即可操作手机、录制流程并在相似任务中复用。
description.en: Debug APKs include and enable the complete GUI/VLM plugin. Install the APK to operate the phone, record flows, and reuse similar tasks.

description.zh: Debug APK 直接内置并校验 OmniFlow、OmniTransfer、模型 checkpoint 和 Python 依赖；Python 解释器由内嵌终端环境提供。
description.en: Debug APKs bundle and verify OmniFlow, OmniTransfer, the model checkpoint, and Python dependencies; the embedded terminal environment provides the Python interpreter.

description.zh: Debug APK 已预置全部官方插件；只需打开无障碍权限即可开始操作手机。
description.en: Debug APKs ship with all official plugins enabled; only Android accessibility permission is needed to control the phone.

title.zh: 不增加基础安装包体积

description.zh: Debug APK 已包含录制、保存、自动复用和跨设备执行所需组件；生产版仍可按需下载以控制包体积。
description.en: Debug APKs include recording, saving, automatic reuse, and cross-device execution components; production builds may download them on demand to keep the base APK small.

title.zh: OmniFlow 自动化增强已启用

steps.zh: 在线执行：回到聊天，直接说“打开蓝牙”或“新建联系人”。
steps.en: Online: return to chat and ask “Turn on Bluetooth” or “Create a contact”.

steps.zh: 录下操作：在聊天中发送“手动录制”，完成后会保存整个操作过程，方便以后再次使用。
steps.en: Record actions: send “Manual recording” in chat. The complete flow is saved for later reuse.

steps.zh: 自动复用：再次提出相似要求时，系统会找到已保存的流程，替换新的联系人、商品或地址后执行。
steps.en: Reuse automatically: for a similar request, the system finds a saved flow, substitutes the new contact, product, or address, and runs it.

label.zh: 已保存操作与执行记录

Canonical RunLog.zh: 查看任务执行的每一步
Canonical RunLog.en: Review every step of a task

RunLog to Function.zh: 把成功操作保存下来重复使用

Function recall and parameter binding.zh: 相似任务自动找到流程并替换新内容
Function recall and parameter binding.en: Find a matching flow and substitute new details

Function replay with OmniTransfer.zh: 换一台手机也能找到对应按钮并执行
Function replay with OmniTransfer.en: Adapt saved actions to another phone

Mobilerun Manager and Executor.zh: 管理并执行已保存的手机操作
Mobilerun Manager and Executor.en: Manage and run saved phone actions

OmniFlow Python runtime.zh: 需要高级能力时自动准备运行环境
OmniFlow Python runtime.en: Prepare advanced automation only when needed

plugins.name: Vibe Builder
plugins.description: Build standalone phone-first Apps linked to Xiaowan, isolated data, and reusable backend connectors.

description.zh: 启用后，Agent 可以生成带独立 HTML 界面和 SVG 桌面图标的小 App，并快速连接小万、可调用工具与隔离数据；发布后作为独立插件管理。
description.en: Enable the Agent to generate a standalone HTML App with an SVG home-screen icon, then link Xiaowan, callable tools, and isolated data behind it as an independent plugin.
